title: The Sovereign AI Paradox: Who Controls the Compute?
content: U.S. restrictions on overseas AI infrastructure could accelerate sovereign computing and weaken American technology dominance. The post The Sovereign AI Paradox: Who Controls the Compute? appeared first on EE Times .

title: T-Mobile pushes ahead with AI-RAN toward 6G
content: T-Mobile plans to share a new AI-RAN development before end of the year as it continues to test Nvidia's GPUs with Nokia and AI in the RAN from Ericsson.

title: MU: TomorrowX Summit (CEO interview)
content: AI-driven demand remains robust, with 75% of 2027 output sold and 2027–2028 supply expected to be tighter than 2026. Multi-year SCAs and planned 2028–2029 stacked DRAM launches underpin visibility and growth.
